mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_place (project_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, latitude, longitude, thumbnail, place_type, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{googlePlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{thumbnail}, #{placeType}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT place_id as placeId, project_id as projectId, google_place_id as googlePlaceId, place_name as placeName, place_address as placeAddress, latitude, longitude, thumbnail, place_type as placeType, created_at as createdAt FROM project_place WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE from project_place WHERE place_id=#{placeId} and project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_place WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND google_place_id = #{googlePlaceId})
